title: TRUMP P6-to-P7 Four-Color Differential Frontier
purpose: Preserve the cleaned P-vs-NP research frontier after eliminating q-Horn distance, Rank-Euler cancellation, affine-contraction-flat enumeration, generic rank-2 cover naming, and coordinate-dependent two-bit representations as standalone universal mechanisms. The next target is the exact structural failure of the known polynomial P6-free 4-coloring compression when lifted to the NP-complete P7-free class.

stage6b4_round1.scientific_meaning: Proof-carrying lower bounds increased on all 13 frozen residuals. This is useful evidence against a tiny practical deletion-qHorn explanation on these instances, but it is not an asymptotic lower bound and does not by itself advance P=NP.

cleaned_equivalence_chain.statement: On a hard paired-graphic subclass, the recent rank-2/nonvanishing formulations collapse exactly to ordinary graph 4-colorability rather than defining a new easier structure.

construction.edge_equivalence: t restricted to U_uv is nonzero iff c(u) != c(v)

cleaned_equivalence_chain.anti_loop_verdict: Do not reintroduce any of these equivalent shadows as a new universal mechanism without a genuinely new polynomial discovery/compression theorem.

pure_rank2_hardness_binding.importance: The linear homogeneous exactly-rank-2 restriction already contains an NP-complete problem. No affine constant, rank-1 gadget, or pre-fixed coordinate is required.
pure_rank2_hardness_binding.implication: A polynomial-time algorithm for arbitrary instances of this exactly-rank-2 nonvanishing core would yield a polynomial-time algorithm for Graph 4-Colorability and hence imply P=NP.
pure_rank2_hardness_binding.proof_obligation_for_future_use: The reduction and both directions of witness reconstruction must be independently machine-checked before it is used as theorem authority.

symmetry_firewall.fact: AGL(2,2) is isomorphic to S4; the affine transformations of F_2^2 realize all 24 permutations of four colors.
symmetry_firewall.consequence: A purported universal mechanism that privileges bit-1, bit-2, a chosen XOR basis, a first/second cut, or a distinguished zero color is suspect as a coordinate artifact.
symmetry_firewall.required_invariance: Candidate invariants intended for the hard 4-color core must survive color relabeling / equivalent affine changes of the F_2^2 color coordinates.

p6_free_4_color.mechanism_of_interest: Polynomial reduction to a polynomial-size collection of excellent precolorings, followed by polynomial handling of those excellent precolorings.

prior_art_boundary.interpretation: The P6-free/P7-free boundary is a known tractability/hardness transition. JANUS must not claim novelty for that boundary. The research target is the exact proof-mechanism differential and any genuinely new polynomial lift.

next_primary_frontier.name: TRUMP_P6_TO_P7_EXCELLENT_PRECOLORING_LIFT_GATE
next_primary_frontier.central_question: Which exact structural lemma or state-compression step makes the P6-free polynomial representative-family construction cease to remain polynomial when induced P7 is permitted, and can that failure be replaced by an exact globally adequate quotient/decomposition whose discovery, solve, reconstruction, and verification costs are all polynomial?
reason_for_priority: P6-free 4-coloring supplies a real neighboring polynomial compression mechanism rather than a hypothetical one.
P7-free 4-coloring is already NP-complete, so a universal polynomial lift to that class would directly imply P=NP.
The one-step forbidden-induced-path boundary provides a controlled differential laboratory instead of an unconstrained search over all SAT representations.
The target is invariant under equivalent color coordinate representations and does not depend on q-Horn closeness.

differential_protocol.source_target: Complete proof/algorithm lineage for P6-free 4-coloring, especially the construction and extension of excellent precolorings.

per_lemma_classification.A: Lemma/operation remains valid for P7-free inputs with the same polynomial bound.
per_lemma_classification.B: Fails on an explicit P7-free witness; freeze the smallest reproducible witness.
per_lemma_classification.C: Fails but a preregistered repair needs only a uniformly bounded/polynomial branching or state expansion.
per_lemma_classification.D: Fails and induces an unbounded/exponential family or hidden exponential discovery step.

differential_protocol.first_goal: Locate the earliest B/C/D transition in the dependency chain, before inventing a repair.
differential_protocol.promotion_rule: No repair is scientifically promoted until the failure witness, input binding, exact semantic obligation, construction cost, reconstruction path, and independent checker are frozen.

killer_gates.requirement: Freeze primary-source statements and algorithm dependencies; distinguish theorem text from JANUS interpretation.
For every P6-specific lemma that fails, produce a small explicit P7-free counterexample and independently verify both P7-freeness and the failed conclusion.
Count every generated precoloring/state/branch/intermediate object. Polynomial output verification is insufficient if discovery enumerates exponentially many candidates.
Reject mechanisms whose claimed compression depends on arbitrary names or coordinates of the four colors rather than invariant instance structure.
Any quotient/decomposition must preserve 4-colorability exactly and must support polynomial witness reconstruction.
Test against P7-free instances from the established NP-hardness construction, not only hand-picked or JANUS-generated easy examples.
No preprocessing step may call or encode an NP-hard subproblem such as optimal representative selection, minimal obstruction discovery, or exhaustive equivalence-class materialization.
T_construct + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify must be bounded by one polynomial in the original input size with a fixed exponent.

forbidden_loops: Promote finite Stage6B.4 exact distances to an asymptotic q-Horn theorem.
Rename 4-colorability as rank-2 cover, two-cut cover, F_2^2 tension, critical exponent, or chromatic-polynomial positivity and treat the renaming as a new algorithm.
Use color-coordinate-specific structure as if it were invariant.
Enumerate all colorings, flats, functionals, subspace intersections, precolorings, or representative candidates and hide the enumeration behind a verifier.
Assume irredundantization/minimal-subcover extraction is free preprocessing.
Treat a polynomial-size certificate as a polynomial-time discovery algorithm.
Infer P=NP from a scoped subclass, finite benchmark, CI success, or proof-carrying instance result.

success_condition.scoped_success: A new exact lemma/quotient/decomposition that strictly extends a frozen P6-free proof component to a larger P7-free surface with polynomial discovery and replay.
success_condition.decisive_global_success: A complete polynomial-time 4-coloring algorithm for all P7-free graphs with exact correctness and total polynomial cost. Because 4-coloring P7-free graphs is NP-complete, such a result would imply P=NP, subject to independent verification and prior-art review.

immediate_next_action: Freeze the primary P6-free excellent-precoloring proof dependency graph and perform a no-repair differential audit against P7-free witnesses. Identify the first exact lemma where the polynomial representative-family argument fails or loses its polynomial bound.
provenance_note: This artifact preserves a strategic research frontier and anti-loop map. It is not a claim of world novelty, peer review, or resolution of P versus NP.
